description:
Goal
Fix native lowering so direct returns can encode reusable-cons structural values without losing the bound source value.

Problem being fixed
The reusable-cons continuation proof is currently red even though the quicksort continuation shape is correct. The minimal repro:

fn ping(x), do: x

fn rebuild(xs) do
  [h | t] = xs
  ping(0)
  [h | t]
end

fn main(), do: rebuild([1, 2])

Concrete repro
cargo test compiler2_native_program_transports_reusable_cons_caps_through_delivered_continuations --lib

Current failure
panic: native lowering referenced unbound value 0 for root 0
backtrace hot path:
- NativeLowerer::return_carrier_var
- NativeLowerer::lower_value_destination
- NativeLowerer::lower_entry_tail
- NativeLowerer::lower_clause_body_fn

Root cause hypothesis
This is a native direct-return seam, not a tuple-field continuation seam. After the return-layout cleanup, `return_carrier_var` assumes the returned semantic value can always be recovered from the local env as one coherent bound value. The reusable-cons rebuild fixture shows a counterexample: the returned value is still structurally representable, but the original semantic value id is not present in the env in the way `return_carrier_var` expects, so native panics before codegen.

Design decision
Fix the native direct-return data model in the right place. Do not special-case the fixture and do not disable reusable-cons transport. Native should encode direct returns from the same structural local-value facts it already carries for tuples and direct callables.

Code seams
- src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs `return_carrier_var` / `lower_value_destination`
- any clause-body binding path that drops the returned structural value before the return seam

Checks
- cargo test compiler2_native_program_transports_reusable_cons_caps_through_delivered_continuations --lib
- cargo test compiler2_native_program_matches_tuple_field_call_continuations_to_the_callee_return_abi --lib
- cargo test compiler2_interp_runs_quicksort_from_backend_artifacts --lib
title: Compiler2 native reusable-cons return-carrier drops a bound structural value
